q: In Revelation, Jesus says, “Behold, I stand at the door and…”
quote: Behold, I stand at the door and knock.

q: In Revelation, what will Jesus do if anyone opens the door?
a: Come in and dine with him
quote: If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in and dine with him, and he with Me.

q: In Revelation, to which church did Jesus say, “I stand at the door and knock”?
why: It was the last of the seven churches.
quote: To the angel of the church in Laodicea write

q: In Revelation, Jesus told the church in Laodicea they were neither cold nor what?
quote: I know your deeds; you are neither cold nor hot.

q: In Revelation, what did the church in Laodicea say about itself?
quote: You say, ‘I am rich; I have grown wealthy and need nothing.’

q: In His letter to Laodicea, whom does Jesus say He rebukes and disciplines?
quote: Those I love, I rebuke and discipline.

q: At the end of His letter to Laodicea, who should hear what the Spirit says?
quote: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.

q: In Revelation, what did John see after the first heaven and earth passed away?
quote: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth

q: In Revelation, which holy city did John see coming down from heaven?
why: It was prepared like a bride.
quote: I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God

q: In the new heaven and earth, what will God wipe from every eye?
quote: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes

q: In the new heaven and earth, what will be no more?
why: The former things have passed away.
quote: and there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain

q: In Revelation, what did the One on the throne say He makes?
why: These words are faithful and true.
quote: Behold, I make all things new.

q: In the new Jerusalem, what was each gate made of?
quote: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls, with each gate consisting of a single pearl.

q: Why does the new Jerusalem need no sun or moon?
quote: because the glory of God illuminates the city, and the Lamb is its lamp.

q: At the end of Revelation, Jesus says, “I am the Alpha and the…”
quote: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.

q: At the end of Revelation, Jesus calls Himself the Beginning and the what?
quote: the Beginning and the End.

q: In Revelation, what flows from the throne of God and of the Lamb?
a: A river of the water of life
quote: Then the angel showed me a river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb

q: In Revelation, which tree stands on either side of the river of life?
quote: On either side of the river stood a tree of life

q: At the end of Revelation, what will there be no more of in the city?
why: The Lord God will shine on them.
quote: There will be no more night in the city

q: At the end of Revelation, what does Jesus promise?
quote: Yes, I am coming soon.

q: At the end of Revelation, Jesus calls Himself the bright what?
quote: I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the bright Morning Star.

q: On which island was John when he received the Revelation?
why: He was there for his testimony.
quote: was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and my testimony about Jesus.

q: In Revelation, to how many churches was John told to send his scroll?
quote: Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches

q: In Revelation, what had the church in Ephesus abandoned?
quote: You have abandoned your first love.

q: In Revelation, what word describes the church in Laodicea?
quote: So because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold

q: In Revelation, what do the four living creatures never stop saying?
why: Day and night they praise God.
quote: Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!

q: In Revelation, who triumphed to open the scroll and its seven seals?
why: He is the Root of David.
quote: Behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed to open the scroll

q: In Revelation, what did the great multitude before the throne hold?
quote: They were wearing white robes and holding palm branches in their hands.

q: In the new Jerusalem, what was the main street made of?
quote: The main street of the city was pure gold, as clear as glass.

q: Why was there no temple in the new Jerusalem?
a: God and the Lamb are its temple
quote: because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.

q: In Revelation, only those whose names are written where may enter the city?
quote: but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s Book of Life.

q: In the new Jerusalem, whose names were written on the twelve gates?
why: An angel stood at each gate.
quote: twelve gates inscribed with the names of the twelve tribes of Israel

q: In the new Jerusalem, whose names were on the twelve foundations?
quote: The wall of the city had twelve foundations bearing the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

q: In Revelation, how many kinds of fruit does the tree of life bear?
quote: bearing twelve kinds of fruit and yielding a fresh crop for each month.

q: In Revelation, what are the leaves of the tree of life for?
quote: And the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.

q: In Revelation, on which day was John in the Spirit?
why: He heard a voice like a trumpet.
quote: On the Lord’s day I was in the Spirit

q: In Revelation, where will God's name be on His servants?
quote: They will see His face, and His name will be on their foreheads.

q: In Revelation, at whose feet did John fall to worship before being stopped?
why: The angel told him to worship God.
quote: I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.
